ir.name: rank_adjacent_positive_gap_gaplinear_weighted
ir.intuition: Select pairs where winner rank is exactly one better (lower) than loser rank and winner's objective is strictly better (lower) than loser's, weighting pairs proportionally to the positive objective gap to increase emphasis on larger meaningful differences and guarantee pairs are found under the gate.

ir.name: weighted_advantage_margin_scaled_logsigmoid_weighted_mean_loss_v5
ir.intuition: To fix the insensitivity to the objective, replaced exponential margin with a direct linear scaling using per-sample advantage magnitude, amplifying differences locally rather than a fixed scalar margin from mean advantage. Also removed norm normalization of (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) to preserve the raw margin signal scale. This introduces a stronger and more locally adaptive margin that enhances sensitivity to advantage variations, improving gradient signal strength while keeping stability with clamping and weighted mean aggregation.
ir.pseudocode:
epsilon=1e-6
abs_adv = abs(advantage_gap)
clamped_adv = clamp(abs_adv, 0, 5)
x_raw = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
x = clamped_adv * x_raw
x = clamp(x, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
loss_weighted = loss * weight
return sum(loss_weighted) / max(sum(weight), epsilon)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    abs_adv = ops.abs(advantage_gap)
    clamped_adv = ops.clamp(abs_adv, 0.0, 5.0)
    x_raw = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    x = ops.mul(clamped_adv, x_raw)
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))
    loss_weighted = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_mean = ops.div(ops.sum(loss_weighted), ops.maximum(ops.sum(weight), epsilon))
    return loss_mean
